note: Moore County, TX (FIPS 48341). Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. The city of Dumas (county seat, largest city) zones under Chapter 14 of its code (Article 14.05, map adopted by reference), but its zoning map is only reachable through a proprietary 3CGeo FIST interactive viewer (City Map for Public), with no public ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning polygon layer found. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches returned no Moore County or Dumas zoning service. Dynamo Spatial parcel shapefile carries zoning codes but is a paid download, not an official queryable layer. Cactus and Sunray: no zoning service found.
